name: OpenOutreach
description: Find B2B leads that fit your product description, explain why each one fits, export a CSV and email them from your own mailbox, with a self-hosted CLI and a Claude Code plugin.

skills.name: Find Leads
skills.description: Finds qualified leads that match your product and target market and prints them as CSV with the reason each one fits.

skills.name: Find Work Emails
skills.description: Buys a verified work email address for each qualified lead from the email-finder provider, one credit per address.

skills.name: Send Outreach
skills.description: Writes and sends opening emails to stored leads from your own mailbox until the requested number of conversations open.
